chunks.text:
Sketchbook 1
Choose one of the following to complete:
Create a Visual Brainstorm Page
Symbol Exploration
Artist Influence Sketches
Fill at least one full page with:
Words
Symbols
Small sketches
Arrows and connections
Do not worry about neatness.
Prompt ideas:
Things I think about often
Things that matter to me
Things I avoid or fear
Things that define my identity
Choose 1 idea from your brainstorm and create:
2–3 symbolic sketches
Try different symbols for the same idea
Ask yourself:
Is this symbol too obvious?
Could I make it more personal?
Create one sketch inspired by one of the featured artists studied.
This does NOT mean copying.
Instead, borrow:
Line style
Symbolic approach
Mood or emotional tone
Label each sketch with:
Artist influence
What you borrowed
What you changed
Written Reflection
Answer in point form or short paragraphs 2 of the following:
What themes or ideas keep reappearing?
Which symbols feel meaningful to you?
Which artist’s approach felt most natural?
What surprised you about this process?
What Strong Sketchbook Work Looks Like
✔ Messy but thoughtful✔ Multiple ideas explored
✔ Notes beside drawings
✔ Visible decision-making
✔ Willingness to abandon weak ideas
✘ One perfect drawing only
✘ No written thinking
✘ Rushing to finished images
Common Mistakes (and How to Avoid Them)
Mistake: Trying to make “good art” too earlyFix: Focus on thinking, not polish
Mistake: Copying symbols from the internetFix: Personal meaning matters more than appearance
Mistake: Skipping reflectionFix: Reflection is part of the artwork
 Complete the following Self Assessment
1. Page Completion & Development
(Creating & Refining / Technical Control)
☐ My page uses the space intentionally (not large empty areas without purpose). ☐ My work shows refinement (not rushed or unfinished). ☐ I took a creative risk or tried something new. ☐ I revised, layered, or improved my work rather than stopping at the first idea. ☐ My craftsmanship reflects Art 30 standards.
Circle your level: 1   2   3   4   5
Brief explanation of your rating:
2. Option Criteria Met
(Following Direction with Conceptual Depth)
☐ I clearly chose one option and followed all required components. ☐ All required elements of the option are visible in my work. ☐ I went beyond the minimum expectations. ☐ My work demonstrates intentional choices rather than accidental outcomes.
Circle your level: 1   2   3   4   5
Brief explanation of your rating:
3. Written Reflection
(Critical Reflection / Expressive Content)
☐ I answered all required reflection questions. ☐ I clearly explained my artistic intention. ☐ I used appropriate art vocabulary (elements, principles, composition, media, etc.). ☐ I identified strengths in my work. ☐ I identified areas for growth or refinement. ☐ I explained how this connects to my personal style, influences, or previous work.
Circle your level: 1   2   3   4   5
Brief explanation of your rating:
Overall Self-Assessment
Based on the criteria above, I believe my overall level for this sketchbook page is:
1   2   3   4   5
What is one specific thing I am proud of in this work?
What is one specific refinement I would make if this were part of my final portfolio?
